raw_text: A completeness bug in the fused logos pipeline was traced to bookkeeping rather than data. Six inferences were flagged incomplete despite having all eight logos dimensions present and valid plus a conflict block, because the fused pass re-tagged every dimension correctly but never cleared pre-existing error markers left over from the retired per-operator path. Those stale errors even referenced a "narrative" dimension that the fused operator no longer produces. Since the completeness check treated any leftover error as incomplete, fully-valid inferences were wedged "incomplete" forever by stale metadata. The initial diagnosis of transient transport failures was wrong, verified by reading the actual files.
